title: pvIOSSCellGridReader
body:
## pvIOSSCellGridReader

Reads IOSS databases (Exodus, including the discontinuous-Galerkin .exdg variant) into a partitioned dataset collection whose partitions are cell grids (vtkCellGrid), ParaView's representation for higher-order and DG cells with attributes defined per cell type. Use it when cell-grid filters (pvCellGridElevation, pvCellGridProbe) or high-order fields are needed; use pvIOSSReader for ordinary unstructured grids accepted by most filters.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Most classic dataset filters do not accept vtkCellGrid; convert or use pvIOSSReader when a later step needs an unstructured grid.
- RemoveUnusedPoints and MergeExodusEntityBlocks of the base IOSS reader are ignored.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `IOSSCellGridReader`. Identity: `sources/IOSSCellGridReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ApplyDisplacements` | Geometric locations can include displacements. When this option is on, the nodal positions are 'displaced' by the standard EXODUS displacement vector. If displacements are turned 'off', the user can explicitly add them by applying a warp filter. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AssemblySelectors` | Specify the selectors for the data assembly chosen using **Assembly** to choose the blocks to extract from the input dataset. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `DisplacementMagnitude` | When displacements are being applied, they are scaled by this amount. Set to 1 for no scaling. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `EdgeSetFields` | Select the edge sets fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `EdgeSets` | Select the edge sets to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ElementBlockFields` | Select the element blocks fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ElementBlocks` | Select the element blocks to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ElementSetFields` | Select the element sets fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ElementSets` | Select the element sets to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FaceSetFields` | Select the face sets fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FaceSets` | Select the face sets to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FieldSuffixSeparator` | Set the character used to separate suffix from the field. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the IOSS reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileRange` | To limit reading a subset of files in spatial file-series, specify a valid range. You may also use **FileStride** to step over files in this range. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1]` |
| `FileStride` | Specify the stride to use when reading a subset of files as dictated by the **FileRange**. | `{"maximum":100,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `GenerateFileId` | When checked, the reader will add a cell array called 'file_id' indicate which partitioned file the cell came from. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GroupNumericVectorFieldComponents` | Set whether the reader should treat numeric suffices for a vector field as vector components of a vtkDataArray. By default, fields with numeric suffices are not grouped into a single vtkDataArray. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NodeBlockFields` | Names of the nodal (point) fields to read, i.e. fields of the node block shared by every block and set, such as displacement, velocity or temperature. vtkIOSSReader enables all fields by default; listing names keeps only these. (The ParaView 5.13.3 XML text says "edge blocks" here, which is a copy error.) | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `NodeSetFields` | Select the node sets fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `NodeSets` | Select the node sets to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ReadAllFilesToDetermineStructure` | When set to true (default), the reader will read all files to determine structure of the dataset because some files might have certain blocks that other files don't have. Set to false if you are sure that all files have the same structure, i.e. same blocks and sets. When set to false, the reader will only read the first file to determine the structure. which is faster than reading all files. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReadGlobalFields` | When checked, the reader will read global fields, if available. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReadIds` | When checked, the reader will read 'ids' and 'element_side' fields, if available. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReadQAAndInformationRecords` | When checked, the reader will read quality assurance and information records, if available. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ScanForRelatedFiles` | This reader can lookup additional related files using pattern matching based on the files provided. This is useful to lookup restarted results, for example. To avoid this behavior, uncheck this property. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SideSetFields` | Select the side sets fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SideSets` | Select the side sets to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `StructuredBlockFields` | Select the structured blocks fields / arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `StructuredBlocks` | Select the structured blocks to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvIOSSCellGridReader",
```
